subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google's Vertex AI rebrand?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but the issue's requested phrase is not the exact official Google wording and provider-id changes would affect compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` ids and runtime behavior.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the existing label until Google SDK/API/docs naming stabilizes further or maintainers decide OpenClaw should keep the familiar Vertex wording.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label and document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex API/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` ids and runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent history on the exact display-label files and adjacent provider-catalog onboarding path.
